Author: ThaleMagnus
Description:

Taken from the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9843]Original[/url] mod page.

[color=#00ffff]"[/color]This mod adds a new gameplay mechanic to Stardew Valley - coin collection!

Every day, the mod randomly buries coins in diggable locations around Stardew Valley. Coins can be dug up with the hoe.

To find coins, purchase a metal detector from Pierre's store and equip it. When you are near a coin, it will beep. The beeps will become louder and higher pitched as you approach the coin.

There is also a green indicator pointing the direction to the nearest coin.[color=#00ffff]"[/color]

[color=#ffffff]This removed the Dynamic Game Assets requirements and includes [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9844]Yoba Coins[/url].[/color]

You can also create your own [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url] Packs. 

Example [url=https://github.com/ThaleTheGreat/ThalesStardewValleyMods/tree/febed79d962b67baeaaed3c0009d461a64b7e2f1/Coin%20Collector%20Redux/%5BCP%5D%20Coin%20Collector%20Redux%20Example%20Coin%20Pack]HERE[/url]. 

You can either craft the metal detector or purchase it from Pierre's.

Coin values are configurable. 

[b]All of my mods and their source code are on [url=https://github.com/ThaleTheGreat/ThalesStardewValleyMods]GitHub[/url][/b]
